title: Context Menu
description: Context menu opens a menu surface at the pointer on right-click. It reuses the same menu list model, keyboard behavior, and submenu flows as ui-menu for consistent command surfaces.
intro: Apply `uiContextMenu` to any host element and pass `uiContextMenuItems` or `uiContextMenuSections`. The directive anchors the overlay to the cursor, closes on outside interaction or Escape, and emits the selected action through `contextMenuItemClick`.
importCode: import { ContextMenuDirective, type MenuItem, type MenuSection } from 'lui';

featureSections.title: Basic right-click surface
featureSections.description: Start with a single host surface and a short action list. This is the most common pattern for canvases, cards, and file rows.

featureSections.title: Sections and shortcuts
featureSections.description: Use grouped sections when the command set is larger or when desktop-style grouping improves scanning speed.

featureSections.title: Nested submenu branches
featureSections.description: Submenus reuse the same nested menu behavior as ui-menu, which keeps export, share, and format trees consistent across trigger types.

accessibility.title: Pointer and keyboard behavior
accessibility.body: The menu opens on the native `contextmenu` event and prevents the browser menu when actions are configured. By default, context menu does not show a focus ring on the first row after a right-click. Keyboard navigation still works: arrow keys move through items, Enter activates, and Escape dismisses.

accessibility.title: Naming and structure
accessibility.body: Provide `uiContextMenuAriaLabel` when multiple context menus on the page need distinct accessible names. Keep action lists short and mirror the labels users already expect from row overflow menus.

accessibility.title: Context menu versus overflow menu
accessibility.body: Use `ui-menu` when the action entry point should stay visible, such as a kebab button in a dense table row. Use `uiContextMenu` when right-click is the primary or secondary affordance on a larger surface.

apiSections.title: ContextMenuDirective - [uiContextMenu]
apiSections.lead: Standalone directive that opens a cursor-anchored menu overlay from the native context menu interaction. It reuses `MenuItem` and `MenuSection` models from the menu package surface.

blocks.title: Inputs
rows: Flat list of menu actions when sections are not used.
Grouped menu sections with optional headers and dividers.
Disables opening the custom context menu.
Maximum height of the menu list before scrolling.
Menu surface variant passed through to `ui-menu-list`.
Menu surface appearance passed through to `ui-menu-list`.
Accessible name for the opened menu surface.
When true, focuses the first action immediately and shows the focus ring. Keep false for pointer-first context menus.

blocks.title: Outputs
rows: Emits when the user selects an action. The overlay closes after emission.
Emits after the overlay is attached.
Emits after the overlay is dismissed.

blocks.title: Notes
paragraphs: At least one item or section is required. When the menu has no content, the native browser context menu is preserved.
Submenu items use the same `submenuItems` model as `ui-menu` and open connected overlays from the active row trigger.
